authority: PROPOSED. Fine-tune a LOCAL open model to emit CANON intent JSON. The tuned model still never becomes the source of truth: its output is re-validated by the deterministic engine, which drops any unknown identifier. Training data is synthetic + correct-by-construction (see ../synthetic/).
goal: Teach a small local model tag discipline: bind only to signals in the machine model, refuse to invent tags/commands/products, emit valid intent JSON.

dataset.format: each row -> chat pair: system=intent_generate template + MACHINE_MODEL + COMPONENT_REGISTRY; user=row.input; assistant=json(row.intent)
dataset.machineContextInjection: For each row, look up row.machineId in machines.jsonl and inject that machine's signals+commands+alarms as MACHINE_MODEL so the label is grounded.
dataset.classBalanceNote: ~70% accept, ~10% reject_expected, ~20% refuse — refusals are up-weighted 1.5x in loss to harden the anti-hallucination guarantee.

baseModelCandidates.why: current-gen, Apache-2.0, strong JSON, hybrid thinking off for determinism
laptop-runnable via Ollama for a safe live demo

method.hardware: 1x A100 80GB (DGX) for 32B/70B; single 24GB GPU or Apple silicon for 7B

metrics.name: zero_invented_tag_rate
metrics.how: every usedSignalId present in that row's machine model

metrics.name: refusal_recall
metrics.how: invented-tag/command/product prompts -> UNKNOWN, never a binding

eval.note: Report base-model vs tuned numbers side by side — the pitch is 'the tuned model hallucinates fewer tags', re-validated by deterministic code regardless.
